scope: Exploratory leave-one-corpus-out replay on six previously inspected corpora.
method: Exact grouped Shapley values for operational and outcome metrics. All nonempty feature subsets retain the same nine-neighbor procedure and are independently standardized and calibrated. The empty subset assigns a constant score and never alerts under the same strict threshold rule.
ranking: Primary net benefit is timely warnings minus false alerts. Early alerts receive no credit. The report also records separate contributions for timely warnings, false alerts avoided, and extra early alerts. The conditional marginal effect omits cases where a signal is the first one added.
